arguments.script: System.Collections.IEnumerator Run(){var map=UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectOfType<UnityEngine.Tilemaps.Tilemap>();var bodies=new System.Collections.Generic.List<UnityEngine.GameObject>();var expected=new System.Collections.Generic.List<float>();var lines=new System.Collections.Generic.List<string>();try{foreach(var line in System.IO.File.ReadAllLines("scripts/tilemap-pillars-20261110/footprints.txt")){var fields=line.Split('|');if(!fields[1].StartsWith("Tube"))continue;var parts=fields.Last().Substring(6).Split(new[]{",",".."},System.StringSplitOptions.None).Select(int.Parse).ToArray();int x=parts[0],y=parts[3]-1;var cell=new UnityEngine.Vector3Int(x,y,0);if(!map.HasTile(cell))throw new System.Exception("Pillar top missing "+fields[1]);if(Enumerable.Range(1,3).Any(d=>map.HasTile(cell+UnityEngine.Vector3Int.up*d)))throw new System.Exception("Probe headroom obstructed "+fields[1]);var center=map.GetCellCenterWorld(cell);var body=new UnityEngine.GameObject(fields[1]+" landing probe");body.layer=7;body.transform.position=center+new UnityEngine.Vector3(0,1.6f,0);body.AddComponent<UnityEngine.CircleCollider2D>().radius=.11f;body.AddComponent<UnityEngine.Rigidbody2D>();var marker=new UnityEngine.GameObject("Visible probe");marker.transform.SetParent(body.transform,false);marker.transform.localScale=UnityEngine.Vector3.one*.22f;var renderer=marker.AddComponent<UnityEngine.SpriteRenderer>();renderer.sprite=UnityEngine.Sprite.Create(UnityEngine.Texture2D.whiteTexture,new UnityEngine.Rect(0,0,1,1),new UnityEngine.Vector2(.5f,.5f),1);renderer.color=UnityEngine.Color.yellow;renderer.sortingOrder=100;bodies.Add(body);expected.Add(center.y+.51f);}yield return new UnityEngine.WaitForSeconds(2f);for(int i=0;i<bodies.Count;i++){if(UnityEngine.Mathf.Abs(bodies[i].transform.position.y-expected[i])>.035f)throw new System.Exception("Landing failed "+bodies[i].name+" y="+bodies[i].transform.position.y+" expected="+expected[i]);lines.Add(bodies[i].name+" PASS");}System.IO.File.WriteAllLines("scripts/tilemap-pillars-20261110/play-tests.txt",lines);}finally{foreach(var body in bodies)UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(body);}}return Run();
arguments.summary: Test actual falling bodies on all thirteen converted pillar tops
